# AegisX UI Library

> Enterprise Angular UI library built on Angular Material with custom theming.
> **101 standalone components** (selector prefix: `ax-`), 4 layouts, 8 services,
> nav-shell system, widget framework, design-token system.

**Companion docs:**
- [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) — rules + decision tree for AI assistants (READ FIRST)
- [`DESIGN.md`](./DESIGN.md) — design philosophy / aesthetic
- [`docs/TOKEN_REFERENCE.md`](./docs/TOKEN_REFERENCE.md) — full `--ax-*` + `--mat-sys-*` reference (609 lines)
- [`docs/THEMING_GUIDE.md`](./docs/THEMING_GUIDE.md) — light/dark + custom themes
- [`docs/components/<category>/<name>.md`](./docs/components/) — per-component pages

---

## Setup

```typescript
// app.config.ts
import { provideAegisxUI } from '@aegisx/ui';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideAegisxUI({ /* optional config */ }),
    // OR composable:
    //   provideAegisxConfig(...),
    //   provideAegisxLayouts(...),
    //   provideAegisxComponents(...),
    //   provideAegisxTheme({ defaultTheme: lightTheme }),
  ],
};
```

All components are **standalone** + tree-shakable:

```typescript
import { AxCardComponent, AxThemeSwitcherComponent } from '@aegisx/ui';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  imports: [AxCardComponent, AxThemeSwitcherComponent],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `<ax-card><ax-theme-switcher /></ax-card>`,
})
```

---

## Layouts (4)

| Component                  | Selector              | When to use                                     |
| -------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `AxEmptyLayoutComponent`   | `ax-empty-layout`     | Login, error pages, standalone views            |
| `AxEnterpriseLayoutComponent` | `ax-enterprise-layout` | Top-nav enterprise dashboard                  |
| `AxSidebarLayoutComponent` | `ax-sidebar-layout`   | Left-nav app shell (most common)                |
| `AxDocsLayoutComponent`    | `ax-docs-layout`      | Documentation site (sidebar + TOC)              |
| `AxDashboardPanelComponent` | `ax-dashboard-panel` | Dashboard sub-region (used inside other layouts) |

All layouts share a **Common API**:
`appName`, `logoUrl`, `navigation`, `showFooter`, `showSettingsMenuItem`,
`(profileClicked)`, `(settingsClicked)`, `(logoutClicked)`, plus content
projection slots `#headerActions`, `#userMenu`, `#footerContent`.

```html
<ax-sidebar-layout
  appName="My App"
  logoUrl="/assets/logo.svg"
  [navigation]="navItems"
  [showFooter]="true"
  (logoutClicked)="logout()">
  <ng-template #headerActions>
    <ax-theme-switcher />
  </ng-template>
  <router-outlet />
</ax-sidebar-layout>
```

---

## Navigation Shell (next-gen layout system)

A composable shell for complex nav patterns. Use when the 4 fixed layouts above
are not flexible enough.

| Component                 | Selector                | Purpose                              |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `AxNavShellComponent`     | `ax-nav-shell`          | Outer shell that wires everything    |
| `AxNavTopbarComponent`    | `ax-nav-topbar`         | Top bar variant                      |
| `AxNavRailComponent`      | `ax-nav-rail`           | Compact icon rail                    |
| `AxNavExpandedComponent`  | `ax-nav-expanded`       | Wide labelled sidebar                |
| `AxAppSwitcherComponent`  | `ax-app-switcher`       | Multi-app launcher                   |
| `AxNavConfigPopoverComponent` | `ax-nav-config-popover` | Per-user nav configuration       |
| `AxNavContextSwitcherComponent` | `ax-nav-context-switcher` | Tenant / workspace switcher  |
| `AxNavUserMenuComponent`  | `ax-nav-user-menu`      | Profile / logout dropdown            |
| `AxNotificationPanelComponent` | `ax-notification-panel` | Slide-out notifications         |

`[axNav]` directive is also available for binding nav state to custom elements.

## Services

```typescript
inject(AxThemeService).setTheme('dark');
inject(AxToastService).success('Saved');
inject(AxDialogService).confirm({ title: 'Delete?', message: '…' });
inject(AxNavigationService).setNavigation(items);
inject(AegisxConfigService).config;
inject(AegisxMediaWatcherService).onMediaChange('(max-width: 960px)');
inject(AxLoadingBarService).show();
inject(AegisxIconService).register(...);
```

Use `inject()` (not constructor DI) and Signals over RxJS where the API allows.

| `provideAegisxConfig()`     | Config only          |

`shake`, `navSlideIn`, `navSlideRight`, `navPopIn`, `navActiveBar`

Plus the bundle: `aegisxAnimations` (everything except nav-shell).

## Theming & Design Tokens (overview)

Two layers of tokens:

1. **Material Design tokens** — `--mat-sys-*` (surface, on-surface, outline,
   primary, error…). These flip light/dark automatically.
2. **AegisX semantic tokens** — `--ax-*` (text, background, border, brand,
   shadow, radius, spacing, typography, motion, component-level button/nav).

Always reference tokens — **never hardcode hex / rgb / hsl** for any
semantic value (color, border, shadow, radius). Layout numerics
(width, height, breakpoints) are fine.

```scss
.card {
  background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container);   // or --ax-bg-surface
  color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface);                // or --ax-text-heading
  border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline-variant);
  border-radius: var(--ax-radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--ax-shadow-sm);
  padding: var(--ax-spacing-md);
}
```

**Full token list:** [`docs/TOKEN_REFERENCE.md`](./docs/TOKEN_REFERENCE.md)
**How theming works:** [`docs/THEMING_GUIDE.md`](./docs/THEMING_GUIDE.md)

### Light / Dark mode

Theme is controlled by `data-theme` on `<html>`, set by `AxThemeService`.
Tokens flip automatically — components do **not** need to know which mode
is active.

> ❌ **Do not** use `.dark` class selectors, `[isDarkMode]` inputs, or
> `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` in component code.
> ❌ **Do not** duplicate styles per mode.
> ✅ Reference tokens once; let the theme switch them.

```html
<!-- Drop this anywhere a header lives -->
<ax-theme-switcher />
```

---

## Tailwind × Material × tokens — interop rules

**Tailwind is layout glue only.** Never use Tailwind utilities for color,
border, shadow, radius, font-size, font-weight, transitions on Material
or AegisX components — they will be overridden by Material's own
styles or, worse, win specificity and break dark mode.

| Allowed Tailwind classes | Forbidden (use components / tokens instead) |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `flex`, `grid`, `gap-*`  | `bg-*`, `text-red-*`, `border-gray-*`       |
| `p-*`, `m-*`, `space-*`  | `rounded-lg`, `shadow-sm/md/lg`             |
| `w-*`, `h-*`, `max-w-*`  | `text-xl`, `font-bold`, `tracking-*`        |
| `col-span-*`, `row-*`    | `transition-*`, `animate-*`                 |
| `hidden`, `block`, `flex`| `hover:bg-*`, `hover:text-*`                |
| `relative`, `absolute`   | `dark:*` variants (handled by tokens)       |
| `sm: md: lg: xl:`        | `bg-opacity-*`, `mix-blend-*`               |

Never override Material internals (`--mdc-*`, `.mat-mdc-*`) directly.
Override the `--ax-button-*`, `--ax-nav-*` semantic wrappers instead —
Material consumes them through theme tokens.

## Recipes (verified APIs)

> Each recipe has been checked against the actual component source.
> Inputs/outputs match `libs/aegisx-ui/src/lib/components/...`.
> Per-component reference (full input list, slots, examples):
> [`docs/components/<category>/<name>.md`](./docs/components/).

### 1. Page scaffold (page-shell + page-header + form-section)

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component } from '@angular/core';
import {
  AxPageShellComponent,
  AxPageHeaderComponent,
  AxFormSectionComponent,
  AxCardComponent,
  type BreadcrumbItem,
} from '@aegisx/ui';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  imports: [AxPageShellComponent, AxPageHeaderComponent, AxFormSectionComponent, AxCardComponent],
  template: `
    <ax-page-shell [breadcrumb]="crumbs">
      <ax-page-header title="Drugs" subtitle="Master drug list" />
      <ax-form-section title="Filters" icon="filter_list">
        <!-- filter row -->
      </ax-form-section>
      <ax-card><!-- table / list --></ax-card>
    </ax-page-shell>
  `,
})
export class DrugsPage {
  readonly crumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
    { label: 'Inventory', link: '/inventory' },
    { label: 'Drugs' },
  ];
}
```

> Breadcrumb sits on `ax-page-shell`, **not** on `ax-page-header`. The header
> has `title` (required), `subtitle`, `headingLevel` (1–6).

### 2. Stat dashboard (`ax-stat-card` has **25 variants** — pick the right one)

`ax-stat-card` is the most versatile component in the library. One
component, 25 layout variants, driven entirely by `[variant]` + a few
variant-specific payload inputs.

> **Catalogue:** [`docs/components/data-display/stat-card.md`](./docs/components/data-display/stat-card.md)
> describes every variant.
> **Live demo (in monorepo):** `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/stat-card-demo.component.ts`
> shows 90+ real usages — open it before guessing inputs.

The 25 variants by family:

| Family            | Variants                                                                  |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Text-only         | `compact` (default), `icon-leading`, `hero`                               |
| With sparkline    | `trend`, `trend-corner`                                                   |
| With progress     | `ring`, `gauge`, `gauge-split`, `progress-steps`                          |
| With comparison   | `comparison`, `compare-period`, `threshold`                               |
| With breakdown    | `breakdown`, `bars`, `inline-bars`, `stacked-bar`, `dual-metric`          |
| With status       | `status`, `journey`                                                       |
| With rich payload | `donut-legend`, `metric-grid`, `heatmap`, `ranking`, `category-browser`, `billboard` |

8 representative recipes (real APIs from demo file):

```typescript
imports: [AxStatGroupComponent, AxStatCardComponent],
template: `
  <ax-stat-group>
    <!-- 1. compact (default) — dense KPI tile -->
    <ax-stat-card icon="payments" color="success"
                  label="Today's sales" [value]="'฿123,456'" />

    <!-- 2. icon-leading — workflow status with 48px icon on the left -->
    <ax-stat-card variant="icon-leading" icon="local_shipping" color="info"
                  label="Pending shipments" [value]="42" iconColor="accent" />

    <!-- 3. hero — oversized value, uppercase label, dashboard headers -->
    <ax-stat-card variant="hero" icon="trending_up" color="primary"
                  label="MRR" [value]="'฿4.2M'" subtitle="+12% MoM" />

    <!-- 4. trend — hero layout + sparkline (needs trendData) -->
    <ax-stat-card variant="trend" icon="medication" color="info"
                  label="Receipts / day" [value]="142"
                  [trendData]="[120, 135, 128, 142, 138, 156, 142]" />

    <!-- 5. trend-corner — Manage.City-style, sparkline tucked in corner -->
    <ax-stat-card variant="trend-corner" color="primary"
                  [value]="'4,582'" label="Active users" subtitle="+12.5%"
                  deltaDirection="up" [trendData]="weeklyActiveUsers" />

    <!-- 6. ring — circular progress (needs progress 0-100) -->
    <ax-stat-card variant="ring" icon="inventory_2" color="warning"
                  label="Budget used" [value]="'72%'" [progress]="72" />

    <!-- 7. comparison — actual vs target horizontal bar -->
    <ax-stat-card variant="comparison" icon="account_balance_wallet" color="info"
                  [value]="3_200_000" label="Revenue" subtitle="this quarter"
                  [target]="5_000_000" targetLabel="฿5M" />

    <!-- 8. status — semantic status dot + lastUpdated timestamp -->
    <ax-stat-card variant="status" icon="check_circle"
                  [value]="'1,234 หน่วย'" label="สต็อกรวม"
                  status="healthy" subtitle="ปลอดภัย"
                  lastUpdated="อัพเดท 2 นาทีที่แล้ว" />
  </ax-stat-group>
`,
```

KPI card (smaller, simpler — for non-stat-card metrics):

```html
<ax-kpi-card variant="simple" label="Conversion"
             [value]="'3.4%'" [change]="0.4" changeType="up"
             changeLabel="vs last week" />
```

> Variants need different payload inputs:
> `trend` / `trend-corner` → `[trendData]: number[]`
> `ring` / `gauge` → `[progress]: 0-100`
> `comparison` → `[target]` + `targetLabel`
> `breakdown` → `[breakdown]: StatCardBreakdownItem[]`
> `metric-grid` / `heatmap` → `[cells]: StatCardGridCell[]`
> `bars` / `inline-bars` → `[barData]` + `[barLabels]`
>
> There is **no** `suffix`/`format` prop — pre-format and pass `[value]`
> as a string. There is **no** `trend-up`/`trend-down` — use `variant="trend"`
> with `trendData` (direction comes from the data).

### 3. List page with empty / loading / error states

```typescript
@Component({
  standalone: true,
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  imports: [
    AxCardComponent, AxLoadingStateComponent,
    AxEmptyStateComponent, AxErrorStateComponent,
    MatTableModule,
  ],
  template: `
    <ax-card>
      @switch (state()) {
        @case ('loading') {
          <ax-loading-state message="กำลังโหลดข้อมูล..." />
        }
        @case ('error') {
          <ax-error-state [showTechnicalCode]="true" [bordered]="true" />
        }
        @case ('empty') {
          <ax-empty-state
            icon="inbox"
            title="ยังไม่มีรายการ"
            message="กดปุ่ม + เพื่อสร้างรายการแรก"
            [actions]="[{ label: 'สร้างรายการ', icon: 'add', primary: true, callback: create }]" />
        }
        @case ('ready') {
          <table mat-table [dataSource]="rows()">
            <!-- column defs -->
          </table>
        }
      }
    </ax-card>
  `,
})
export class DrugsListPage {
  readonly state = signal<'loading' | 'error' | 'empty' | 'ready'>('loading');
  readonly rows = signal<Drug[]>([]);
  create = () => this.router.navigate(['/drugs/new']);
}
```

> `ax-error-state` uses signal inputs (`showTechnicalCode`, `bordered`,
> `compact`, `showDetails`, `hideActions`). `ax-empty-state` actions are
> typed `EmptyStateAction[]` — each item has `label`, `icon?`, `primary?`,
> `onClick`.

### 4. Data table (use Material — there is no `ax-data-table`)

```typescript
imports: [AxCardComponent, MatTableModule, MatSortModule, MatPaginatorModule],
template: `
  <ax-card>
    <table mat-table matSort [dataSource]="rows()" class="ax-data-table">
      <ng-container matColumnDef="code">
        <th mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef mat-sort-header>Code</th>
        <td mat-cell *matCellDef="let r">{{ r.code }}</td>
      </ng-container>
      <ng-container matColumnDef="name">
        <th mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>Name</th>
        <td mat-cell *matCellDef="let r">{{ r.name }}</td>
      </ng-container>
      <tr mat-header-row *matHeaderRowDef="cols"></tr>
      <tr mat-row *matRowDef="let row; columns: cols"></tr>
    </table>
    <mat-paginator [length]="total()" pageSize="25" [pageSizeOptions]="[25, 50, 100]" />
  </ax-card>
`,
```

> `class="ax-data-table"` is just a styling hook (defined in `tailwind.config.js`)
> — it is **not** a component selector. AegisX does not wrap `mat-table`.

### 5. Confirm dialog (Observable — wrap with `firstValueFrom`)

```typescript
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import { AxDialogService } from '@aegisx/ui';

const dialog = inject(AxDialogService);

const confirmed = await firstValueFrom(
  dialog.confirm({
    title: 'Delete drug?',
    message: 'This action cannot be undone.',
    confirmText: 'Delete',
    color: 'error',
  }),
);
if (confirmed) await this.delete();
```

> `confirm()` returns `Observable<boolean>` — `await` directly will resolve
> to the Observable, not the result. Always `firstValueFrom()`.

### 6. Drawer (slide-over panel)

```typescript
imports: [AxDrawerComponent, MatButtonModule],
template: `
  <button mat-flat-button (click)="open.set(true)">Open</button>

  <ax-drawer
    [(open)]="open"
    position="right"
    size="md"
    title="Drug detail"
    subtitle="DRG-001"
    icon="medication"
    [hasBackdrop]="true">
    <p>Drawer content here…</p>
  </ax-drawer>
`,
```

```typescript
readonly open = signal(false);
```

> `position`: `'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom'`.
> `size`: `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full'`.

### 7. Tab pills (filter switcher)

```typescript
import { AxTabPillsComponent, type TabPill } from '@aegisx/ui';

readonly tabs: TabPill[] = [
  { value: 'all',     label: 'All',      count: 142 },
  { value: 'active',  label: 'Active',   count: 138 },
  { value: 'expired', label: 'Expired',  count: 4 },
];
readonly active = signal('all');

template: `
  <ax-tab-pills [tabs]="tabs" [activeValue]="active()" (tabChange)="active.set($event)" />
`,
```

> `tabs` is required. `tabChange` emits the selected `value` (string).

### 8. Form section group (collapsible)

```typescript
imports: [AxFormSectionComponent, MatFormFieldModule, MatInputModule],
template: `
  <ax-form-section title="Basic info" icon="info" fieldCount="4" [collapsible]="true">
    <mat-form-field><mat-label>Code</mat-label><input matInput /></mat-form-field>
    <mat-form-field><mat-label>Name</mat-label><input matInput /></mat-form-field>
  </ax-form-section>

  <ax-form-section title="Pricing" icon="payments" [collapsible]="true" [collapsed]="true">
    <!-- starts collapsed -->
  </ax-form-section>
`,
```

> `title` is `input.required<string>()` — must pass it. `collapsible`
> defaults to `true`, `collapsed` (initial state) defaults to `false`.

### 9. Date picker (with min/max + helper)

```typescript
imports: [AxDatePickerComponent, ReactiveFormsModule],
template: `
  <ax-date-picker
    label="Expiry date"
    placeholder="Select expiry"
    [required]="true"
    size="md"
    [minDate]="today"
    helperText="Drugs expiring within 6 months will be flagged"
    [formControl]="expiryCtrl" />
`,
```

```typescript
readonly today = new Date();
readonly expiryCtrl = new FormControl<Date | null>(null, Validators.required);
```

### 10. File upload (with constraints)

```typescript
imports: [AxFileUploadComponent],
template: `
  <ax-file-upload
    label="Upload drug list (CSV, max 10 MB)"
    accept=".csv,text/csv"
    [multiple]="false"
    [maxFiles]="1"
    [maxSize]="10 * 1024 * 1024"
    hint="ใช้ template จาก /downloads/drug-template.csv"
    (filesChange)="onFiles($event)" />
`,
```

```typescript
import { type FileItem } from '@aegisx/ui';

onFiles(files: FileItem[]) {
  if (!files.length) return;
  this.import(files[0].file);
}
```

### 11. Loading button (async submit)

```typescript
imports: [AxLoadingButtonComponent],
template: `
  <ax-loading-button
    variant="flat"
    color="primary"
    type="submit"
    icon="save"
    [loading]="saving()"
    loadingText="กำลังบันทึก..."
    (axClick)="save()">
    บันทึก
  </ax-loading-button>
`,
```

```typescript
readonly saving = signal(false);

async save() {
  this.saving.set(true);
  try { await this.api.save(); } finally { this.saving.set(false); }
}
```

> Use `ax-loading-button` **only** for buttons with real async state.
> Plain confirm/close buttons should be `<button mat-button>`.

### 12. Master-detail layout (with persistent splitter)

```typescript
imports: [AxMasterDetailComponent, AxSplitterComponent],
template: `
  <ax-master-detail [masterWidth]="340" masterPosition="left" [showDivider]="true">
    <div master>
      <!-- list -->
    </div>
    <div detail>
      <!-- selected item -->
    </div>
  </ax-master-detail>
`,
```

For a draggable splitter that remembers user width:

```html
<ax-splitter
  orientation="horizontal"
  unit="percent"
  [size]="35"
  [min]="20"
  [max]="60"
  stateKey="drugs-list-width"
  stateStorage="local">
  <div before><!-- left pane --></div>
  <div after><!-- right pane --></div>
</ax-splitter>
```

### 13. Skeleton placeholder while loading

```typescript
imports: [AxCardComponent, AxSkeletonTableComponent, AxSkeletonCardComponent],
template: `
  <ax-card>
    @if (loading()) {
      <ax-skeleton-table [rows]="5" [columns]="4" [showHeader]="true" />
    } @else {
      <!-- real table -->
    }
  </ax-card>
`,
```

### 14. Toast notifications

```typescript
import { AxToastService } from '@aegisx/ui';

private readonly toast = inject(AxToastService);

async save() {
  try {
    await this.api.save();
    this.toast.success('บันทึกสำเร็จ');
  } catch (err) {
    this.toast.error('บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ — โปรดลองอีกครั้ง');
  }
}
```

> `AxToastService` exposes `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info`, `show`.
> Each accepts `(message, options?)` and returns a `ToastRef`.

### 15. Priority alert (urgent banner with chips)

```typescript
import { AxPriorityAlertComponent, type PriorityAlertChip } from '@aegisx/ui';

readonly criticalChips: PriorityAlertChip[] = [
  { label: 'หมดอายุ ≤ 7 วัน 3 รายการ', color: 'error',   link: '/drugs?filter=expiring-week' },
  { label: 'สต็อกต่ำ 5 รายการ',          color: 'warning', link: '/drugs?filter=low-stock' },
];

template: `
  <ax-priority-alert
    variant="error"
    icon="priority_high"
    title="งานเร่งด่วน 8 รายการ"
    subtitle="ต้องดำเนินการก่อนสิ้นวัน"
    [chips]="criticalChips" />
`,
```

### 16. Badge (12 colors × 3 variants × features)

`ax-badge` is a small status / counter pill. It carries the most
configuration of any "tiny" component because it doubles as a status
chip, a counter bubble, a removable filter pill, and a leading/trailing
icon label.

> **Live demo (in monorepo):** `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/badge-showcase.component.ts`
> renders 111 instances across every color/variant/size/feature combo.

**Type unions:**

```typescript
type BadgeVariant = 'soft' | 'outlined' | 'outlined-strong';
type BadgeType    =
  // 5 semantic
  | 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'neutral'
  // 7 extended (Untitled UI palette)
  | 'brand' | 'blue' | 'indigo' | 'purple' | 'pink' | 'orange' | 'sky';
type BadgeSize    = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
```

**Common patterns:**

```html
<!-- Status chip (semantic color, soft variant by default) -->
<ax-badge color="success">Active</ax-badge>
<ax-badge color="warning" icon="schedule">Pending</ax-badge>
<ax-badge color="error" variant="outlined-strong">Critical</ax-badge>

<!-- Counter bubble (square + counter) -->
<ax-badge color="error" [counter]="12" [iconOnly]="true" />

<!-- Dot indicator (8px solid circle) -->
<ax-badge color="success" [dot]="true" />

<!-- Removable filter pill -->
<ax-badge color="info" [removable]="true" (remove)="removeFilter()">
  Status: Active
</ax-badge>

<!-- Extended palette -->
<ax-badge color="purple" variant="soft">Beta</ax-badge>
<ax-badge color="orange" variant="outlined" icon="local_fire_department">Hot</ax-badge>

<!-- Sizes -->
<ax-badge size="sm" color="neutral">Small</ax-badge>
<ax-badge size="md" color="neutral">Medium (default)</ax-badge>
<ax-badge size="lg" color="neutral">Large</ax-badge>
```

> Use `color="success|error|warning|info|neutral"` for semantic states
> (auto-flips per theme). Use the extended palette
> (`brand|blue|indigo|purple|pink|orange|sky`) only for non-semantic
> categorical labels (tags, channels, brand colors). The 3 variants
> trade off prominence: `soft` (default, low-key) → `outlined`
> (medium) → `outlined-strong` (loud).

---

## Real-world page templates

The monorepo ships **9 ready-made page templates** that combine
multiple `ax-*` components into production-grade page shells. **Open
these before scaffolding a new page from scratch** — they are the
canonical "how to lay out a page in AegisX" reference.

| Template | Path (in monorepo) | Use for |
| -------- | ------------------ | ------- |
| **L1 — List page** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l1-list-page-demo.component.ts` | Master list with filters, table, pagination |
| **L2 — Dashboard** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l2-dashboard-demo.component.ts` | KPI dashboard (stat-card grid + charts) |
| **L3 — Record** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l3-record-page-demo.component.ts` | Single-record detail view (PR/PO/case file) |
| **L4 — Workflow** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l4-workflow-demo.component.ts` | Stepper-based wizard (horizontal + vertical) |
| **L5 — Form** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l5-form-demo.component.ts` | Long settings form, grouped sections |
| **L6 — Split** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l6-split-demo.component.ts` | Master-detail with `ax-master-detail` |
| **L7 — Hub** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l7-hub-demo.component.ts` | Module landing page (cards as entry points) |
| **L8 — Settings** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l8-settings-demo.component.ts` | Untitled UI "big card" settings layout |
| **L9 — Dashboard panel** | `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/l9-dashboard-panel-demo.component.ts` | Manage.City-style dashboard composition |

Plus 3 component showcases (each renders every variant of one component):

- `stat-card-demo.component.ts` — 25 variants × multiple colors (90+ instances)
- `badge-showcase.component.ts` — 12 colors × 3 variants × features (111 instances)
- `icon-showcase.component.ts` — Material icon catalogue used across the app

Routes live in `apps/web/src/app/features/layouts-demo/layouts-demo.routes.ts`.
Visit `http://localhost:4200/layouts-demo/...` while running `pnpm run dev:web`.

---

## File layout (source of truth)

```
libs/aegisx-ui/src/lib/
├── components/      # 101 ax-* components in 22 sub-dirs
├── layouts/         # ax-empty / ax-enterprise / ax-sidebar / ax-docs / ax-dashboard-panel
├── navigation/      # ax-nav-shell + features + animations + models
├── services/        # 8 services (theme, toast, dialog, navigation, config, media-watcher, loading-bar, icon)
├── providers/       # provideAegisxUI / provideAegisxTheme / etc.
├── widgets/         # 8 widget components
├── theme/           # lightTheme, darkTheme, brandTheme, createCustomTheme
├── animations/      # 11 main + 4 nav-shell animations
├── foundations/     # design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, radius, shadows, motion)
├── types/           # public TypeScript interfaces
└── utils/           # helpers
```

---

## Types & interfaces

```typescript
import type {
  AxNavigationItem,    // sidebar/topbar nav items
  AxNavigation,        // full nav config
  AegisxConfig,        // library config
  ThemeConfig,         // theme definition
  LayoutType,          // 'empty' | 'enterprise' | 'sidebar' | 'docs'
} from '@aegisx/ui';
```

```typescript
interface AxNavigationItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  type?: 'basic' | 'collapsable' | 'group';
  icon?: string;
  link?: string;
  children?: AxNavigationItem[];
  badge?: { title: string; classes?: string };
}
```

---

## Versioning & subtree

This library is mirrored to `github.com/aegisx-platform/aegisx-ui` via
`sync-to-repo.sh`. Edits should land in the AegisX monorepo first; the
sync script copies them out. Breaking changes are capped at minor bumps
(see `.releaserc.json`) — v2 requires explicit version bump.
